units: <cite ref="Tosefta Bekhorot 3:8">Tosef. Bekh. III, 8</cite> <he>שכר עֵדָתוֹ</he> ed. Zuck. (oth. ed. <he>עדותו</he>) pay for his testimony.—Pl. <cite ref="P00127"><he>עֵדוֹת</he></cite>.
Bekh. IV, 6 (29ᵃ) עֵדוֹתָיו בטילין masc. (Var. in Mish. ed. עדותו בטילה) his testimonies are void; (Kidd. 58ᵇ עדותו בטילה).
